title: tools/crypto2dev_benchmark.c: throughput benchmark vs kernel built-in
description:
Benchmark tool comparing /dev/wolfcrypt vs kernel built-in crypto.

Tests via /dev/wolfcrypt streaming interface:
1. AES-CBC-256: 1 MB encrypt, measure MB/s
2. AES-GCM-256: 1 MB encrypt+auth, measure MB/s
3. SHA-256: 1 MB hash, measure MB/s

Each benchmark: open fd, INIT, then loop writing 64KB chunks + reading output, close fd. Repeat 100 times, report mean ± stddev.

Parallel comparison: same workloads via AF_ALG sockets (kernel built-in, if loaded).

Output table:
  Algorithm          wolfkm (MB/s)   built-in (MB/s)   ratio
  aes-cbc-256        1234            1100              1.12x
  aes-gcm-256         890             820              1.09x
  sha-256            2100            1900              1.11x

Compile: gcc -O2 -o wolfkm_benchmark wolfkm_benchmark.c
design: Use clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) for timing. AF_ALG interface: AF_ALG socket, bind, accept, setsockopt, send/recv. /dev/wolfcrypt interface: open, SESSION_NEW, CRYPT loop, SESSION_FREE. Both tests on same data buffer to minimize measurement noise. See DESIGN.md §tools.
